candidate_relations.reason: The L5 intravertebral vacuum cleft and MRI double-line sign support Kummell disease. The candidate describes generic osteoporotic compression fractures, omitting vertebral osteonecrosis/delayed collapse and extending that diagnosis to L2 without supporting evidence.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Attributes both L2 and L5 fractures to osteoporosis rather than identifying delayed vertebral osteonecrosis (Kummell disease), principally at L5.
